# morphir-scala agent guidance

Scala 3.7.4; Mill 1.1.x; ZIO; ScalaJS; experimental Scala Native. Shared business-logic library and JVM tooling.

**AI agents MUST NOT be listed as authors or co-authors of git commits.**
FINOS requires contributors to have a signed CLA; AI agents cannot sign CLAs.
Do NOT use `Co-authored-by:` trailers for AI agents
Do NOT add AI agents to commit author fields
The human developer who reviews and commits the code is the sole author
This is FINOS-wide policy.

## Build and test
Use mise:
- `mise run setup` — install tooling
- `mise run lint` — check formatting
- `mise run fmt` — format code
- `mise run test:jvm` — JVM tests
- `mise run test:js` — JS tests
- `mise run ci:local` — full local CI

Or Mill:
- `./mill morphir[3.7.4].jvm.compile`
- `./mill morphir[3.7.4].jvm.test`
- `./mill mill.scalalib.scalafmt.ScalafmtModule/reformatAll 'morphir.__.sources'`
- `./mill morphir[3.7.4].__.jvm.test`

Use `./mill --no-server -j 1` for deterministic builds. Use `./mill resolve __` to list targets; `./mill show <target>.sources` to inspect source paths.

## Sources and conventions
For `morphir/foo/`: `src/` shared; `jvm/src/` JVM; `js/src/` ScalaJS; `src-3/` Scala 3.x; `jvm/src-3.7/` JVM + Scala 3.7.x. Build: `build.mill`; helpers: `mill-build/src/`; modules: `morphir/`; mise tasks: `.config/mise/`; legacy deps: `project/`.

Scalafmt 3.10.4, Scala 3 dialect, 120-column limit. Run `mise run fmt` before committing. Use `given`/`using`, prefer `enum` where appropriate, `derives`, extension methods, `*` imports, and `mvn""` (not deprecated Mill 1.x `ivy""`). Prefer ZIO libraries; tests use ZIO Test, live in `test/src/`, and use `ZIOSpecDefault`.

Add modules by defining them in `build.mill`, creating cross-platform source directories, adding `platformSpecificModuleDeps` if needed, and updating parent dependencies. Check Scala 3.7.4 compatibility, source placement, and deprecated syntax; run `mise run lint`.

## Completion and CI
CI includes Scalafmt lint, JVM tests (Java 21, 25), ScalaJS tests, and Sonatype publishing (main/tags only). Runs on PRs, pushes to main/0.4.x, releases, and manual triggers.

Successful implementation requires a **fully green build** on the PR and resolution of **all** review comments.
Work is NOT complete until all CI checks pass on the Pull Request.
